---
title: "CHOP test menu collection"
output: html_document
params:
  collect: true
  preflight_only: false
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE, message=NA}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = FALSE)
source("R/source.R")
source("R/history.R")
preflight_only <- isTRUE(params$preflight_only) || history_flag("OLSD_PREFLIGHT_ONLY")
history_log("REPORT_START", paste("diagnostics=", history_diagnostics_version,
  "; execution=", if (preflight_only) "preflight-only" else if (isTRUE(params$collect)) "full-collection" else "existing-run", sep = ""))
board <- history_board()
run <- NULL
snapshot <- NULL
if (preflight_only) {
  storage <- history_preflight(board)
  rmarkdown::output_metadata$set(rsc_email_subject = "CHOP storage preflight", rsc_email_suppress_scheduled = TRUE)
} else {
  result <- if (isTRUE(params$collect)) history_collect(board) else {
    if (!pins::pin_exists(board, history_name("last-attempt"))) stop("No collection status available. Use OLSD_PREFLIGHT_ONLY=true for a storage-only check.")
    pins::pin_read(board, history_name("last-attempt"))
  }
  manifest <- history_manifest(board)
  if (!length(manifest$runs)) stop("No accepted snapshot is available on this board and pin prefix.")
  run <- tail(manifest$runs, 1)[[1]]
  snapshot <- history_snapshot(board, run)
  storage <- if (!is.null(run$storage)) run$storage else history_storage_info(board)
  changed_tests <- length(unique(vapply(run$events, `[[`, "", "test_id")))
  app_url <- Sys.getenv("OLSD_APP_URL")
  if (nzchar(app_url)) app_url <- paste0(sub("/$", "", app_url), "/?run=", utils::URLencode(run$id, reserved = TRUE))
  rmarkdown::output_metadata$set(
    rsc_email_subject = paste("CHOP test menu:", if (run$baseline) "baseline established" else paste(changed_tests, "changed tests")),
    rsc_email_body_text = paste("CHOP test menu:", run$count, "tests collected at", display_time(run$collected_at),
      if (run$baseline) "Initial baseline established." else paste(changed_tests, "changed tests;", run$event_count, "field/status events."),
      if (nzchar(app_url)) paste("Review changes:", app_url) else "See the attached report."),
    rsc_email_suppress_scheduled = !run$baseline && run$event_count == 0
  )
}
locations <- history_pin_rows(board, run)
history_log("REPORT_READY", paste("diagnostics=", history_diagnostics_version,
  "; storage=", storage$mode, "; execution=", if (preflight_only) "preflight-only" else "accepted-run", sep = ""))
```

```{r outcome, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat("Diagnostics version: **", history_diagnostics_version, "**\n\n", sep = "")
if (preflight_only) {
  cat("**Storage preflight passed.** A small diagnostic pin was written and read back. No test-menu pages were collected and the accepted baseline was not changed.\n\n")
  cat("Set `OLSD_PREFLIGHT_ONLY=false` before the next full collection.\n\n")
} else {
  cat("Collected **", run$count, " tests** at ", display_time(run$collected_at), ".\n\nRun: `", run$id, "`\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Storage and configuration

Only variable presence is recorded; credential values are omitted.

```{r storage, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(history_storage_rows(storage))
```

## Pin locations

The name, owning account, content GUID, and published URL identify the destination. In Connect, the snapshot pin's display title is `OLSD run <run ID>`, which differs from its internal pin name. During a storage-only preflight, the diagnostic pin is created; run/index pins may not exist yet.

```{r locations, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(locations)
```

```{r provenance, echo=FALSE}
if (!is.null(snapshot) && identical(snapshot$source_mode, "archive")) {
  cat("Reprocessed retained source pages; this was not a new live website collection. Source capture window:",
      display_time(snapshot$source_window$first), "to", display_time(snapshot$source_window$last), "\n")
}
```

```{r summary, echo=FALSE}
if (!is.null(run)) {
  if (run$baseline) cat("Initial baseline established. Future accepted runs will be compared with it.\n")
  else if (!length(run$events)) cat("No changes detected.\n")
  else {
    counts <- table(vapply(run$events, `[[`, "", "type"))
    types <- names(counts)
    tests <- vapply(types, function(type) length(unique(vapply(Filter(function(e) e$type == type, run$events), `[[`, "", "test_id"))), 1L)
    knitr::kable(data.frame(type = types, tests = tests, events = as.integer(counts)))
  }
}
```

```{r link, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(run) && nzchar(app_url)) cat("[Review this run in the history application](", app_url, ")\n", sep = "")
```

```{r changes, echo=FALSE}
if (!is.null(run) && length(run$events)) {
  rows <- lapply(run$events, function(e) data.frame(
    test = e$name, id = e$test_id, type = e$type,
    field = if (is.null(e$field)) "" else e$field
  ))
  knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, rows))
}
```
